translations.web: They covet fields, and seize them; and houses, and take them away: and they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
translations.bsb: They covet fields and seize them; they take away houses. They deprive a man of his home, a fellow man of his inheritance.
translations.kjv: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
translations.asv: And they covet fields, and seize them; and houses, and take them away: and they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
